function AppController.new()
	local self = setmetatable({connections = {}, requestId = 0, page = "Army", selected = nil,
		confirm = nil, panelKey = "", reducedMotion = false, toastSerial = 0, alive = true,
		recruitIntents = {}, recruitReceipts = {}, productionRequests = {}, productionReceipts = {}, menuBlurOwners = {}}, AppController)
	self.audio = AudioController.new()
	self.feedback = ActionFeedback.new(self)
	self.eggs = EggController.new(self)
	self.commerce = CommerceController.new(self)
	self.progression=ProgressionBrowser.new(self)
	self.upgradeBoard=UpgradeBoardController.new(self)
	self.eggBoard=EggProcessorController.new(self)
	self.offlineCash=OfflineCashController.new(self)
	self.base, self.battle = BaseController.new(self), BattleController.new(self)
	return self
end

function AppController:Request(action, payload)
	if not Config.Features.Merging and (action=="OpenMerge" or action=="Merge" or action=="MergeAll") then return nil end
	self.requestId += 1
	local request = payload or {}
	request.action, request.id = action, self.requestId
	local productionKey=if action=="Income" then "EggValue" elseif action=="BoardUpgrade" then request.upgradeKey else nil
	if productionKey=="EggValue" or productionKey=="EggSpeed" then
		local offer=self.state and self.state.boardUpgrades and self.state.boardUpgrades[productionKey]
		if offer then
			-- Keep the displayed server offer with this request; the reply has no upgrade key.
			self.productionRequests[request.id]={key=productionKey,level=offer.level,currentText=offer.currentText,
				expiresAt=os.clock()+30}
		end
	end
	self.remotes.RequestAction:FireServer(request)
	return self.requestId
end


function AppController:NoticePosition()
	-- Menu feedback sits over the dimmed HUD, away from purchase controls.
	local height=self.gui.AbsoluteSize.Y
	local noticeHeight=self.toastFrame.Size.Y.Scale*height+self.toastFrame.Size.Y.Offset
	local top=math.max(if self.panel.Visible then 82 else height*0.24,noticeHeight+12)
	return UDim2.new(0.5,0,0,top)
end

function AppController:SizeNotice()
	local available=self.gui.AbsoluteSize
	if available.X<=0 or available.Y<=0 then return end
	local width=math.max(48,math.min(720,available.X-24))
	local compact=available.X<700 or available.Y<500
	local outline=if compact then 2.5 else 3
	self.toast:SetAttribute("OutlineThickness",outline)
	self.toast.TextSize=if compact then 28 else 34
	self.toast.TextOutline.Thickness=outline
	local bounds=TextService:GetTextSize(self.toast:GetAttribute("PlainText") or "",self.toast.TextSize,
		self.toast.Font,Vector2.new(width-24,10000))
	-- Wrap naturally instead of shrinking text or clipping two-line receipts.
	self.toastFrame.Size=UDim2.fromScale(width/available.X,math.max(52,bounds.Y+24)/available.Y)
end

function AppController:Notify(text, ok)
	if not text or text == "" then return end
	local kind=if type(ok)=="string" and Theme.NotificationStyles[ok] then ok
		elseif ok==false then "error" elseif ok==true then "success" else "info"
	if kind=="error" then
		self.audio:Play("Error",nil,{voiceKey="ErrorNotification",cooldown=0.25})
	end
	local repeated=self.toastFrame.Visible and self.noticeText==text and self.noticeKind==kind
	self.noticeText,self.noticeKind=text,kind
	self.toastSerial += 1
	local serial = self.toastSerial
	Theme.SetNotification(self.toast,text,kind)
	self:SizeNotice()
	Theme.Motion:Toast(self.toastFrame,true,self:NoticePosition(),repeated)
	if self.toastDelay then task.cancel(self.toastDelay) end
	local duration=math.clamp(#text/24+1,if kind=="error" or kind=="warning" then 5 else 4,8)
	self.toastDelay=task.delay(duration, function()
		self.toastDelay=nil
		if self.alive and serial == self.toastSerial then Theme.Motion:Toast(self.toastFrame,false) end
	end)
end

function AppController:Pet(id)
	if not self.state or not id then return nil end
	for _, pet in self.state.pets do if pet.id == id then return pet end end
	return nil
end

function AppController:TrackProductionUpgrade(result)
	if result.action~="BoardUpgrade" and result.action~="Income" then return false end
	if self.productionReceipts[result.id] then return true,false end
	local requested=self.productionRequests[result.id]
	if not requested then return false end
	self.productionRequests[result.id]=nil
	if not result.ok then return false end
	self.productionReceipts[result.id]=os.clock()+600
	local offer=self.state.boardUpgrades and self.state.boardUpgrades[requested.key]
	if not offer or offer.level~=requested.level+1 then
		self:Notify(result.message,true)
		return true,true
	end
	local name=if requested.key=="EggSpeed" then "Egg Speed" else "Egg Value"
	local benefit=if requested.key=="EggSpeed" then "Every chicken produces more eggs" else "Same value for every new egg"
	self:Notify(name..": "..requested.currentText.." → "..offer.currentText.."\n"..benefit,true)
	return true,true
end

-- Purchase classification describes selection, not a bird arriving at a battle.
-- Keep that identity independently of any encounter so late replication and a
-- later first deployment cannot drop the acknowledgement or replay an old one.
function AppController:TrackRecruit(result)
	local recruit, id = result.recruit, result.petId
	if type(recruit) ~= "table" or type(id) ~= "string"
		or (recruit.assignment ~= "Added" and recruit.assignment ~= "Replacement" and recruit.assignment ~= "Reserve") then return false end
	if self.recruitReceipts[id] then return true, false end
	local now = os.clock()
	self.recruitReceipts[id] = now + 600
	local pet = self:Pet(id)
	local definition = pet and Catalog[pet.species]
	local name = definition and definition.name or "Chicken"
	local assignment = recruit.assignment
	self.recruitIntents[id] = {petId = id, assignment = assignment, createdAt = now, expiresAt = now + 600,
		pendingBattleId = recruit.pendingBattleId, deferred = recruit.deferredUntilContestEnds == true,
		selectedOnce = assignment ~= "Reserve",
		homeAcknowledged = false, arrivalAcknowledged = false, contributionAcknowledged = false}
	local classification
	if assignment == "Reserve" then
		classification = "Reserve"
	else
		classification = if assignment == "Added" and type(recruit.selectedBefore) == "number" and type(recruit.selectedAfter) == "number"
			then "Squad " .. recruit.selectedBefore .. " → " .. recruit.selectedAfter else assignment
		if recruit.deferredUntilContestEnds then classification ..= " · joins after this contest"
		elseif recruit.pendingBattleId then classification ..= " · marching" end
	end
	-- Per-bird potential, not a promise of net home income or cash paid immediately.
	local identity=name
	if pet and type(pet.eggsPerSecond)=="number" then
		local width=math.max(1,self.toast.AbsoluteSize.X)
		identity=EggFeedback.Fit(pet.eggsPerSecond,name.." · "," eggs/s at home",width,self.toast.TextSize,false,true)
		if EggFeedback.Width(identity,self.toast.TextSize)>width then
			identity=EggFeedback.Fit(pet.eggsPerSecond,name.." · "," eggs/s",width,self.toast.TextSize,false,true)
		end
		-- Preserve identity and assignment if a very narrow viewport cannot fit the optional rate.
		if EggFeedback.Width(identity,self.toast.TextSize)>width then identity=name end
	end
	local text=identity.."\n"..classification
	self:Notify(text, true)
	self.feedback:Action("Buy")
	-- Bound presentation history independently of inventory size.
	local count, oldestId, oldest = 0, nil, math.huge
	for petId, intent in self.recruitIntents do
		count += 1
		if intent.createdAt < oldest then oldestId, oldest = petId, intent.createdAt end
	end
	if count > 24 and oldestId then self.recruitIntents[oldestId] = nil end
	return true, true
end

function AppController:StepRecruitFeedback()
	if not self.state then return end
	local now = os.clock()
	for id, expires in self.recruitReceipts do if now >= expires then self.recruitReceipts[id] = nil end end
	for id, expires in self.productionReceipts do if now >= expires then self.productionReceipts[id] = nil end end
	for id, request in self.productionRequests do if now >= request.expiresAt then self.productionRequests[id] = nil end end
	for id, intent in self.recruitIntents do
		local pet = self:Pet(id)
		if now >= intent.expiresAt or not pet then self.recruitIntents[id] = nil;continue end
		if intent.deferred then
			-- Buy confirms the active lock. BattleChanged uses another stream and
			-- may still cache the same encounter's earlier, unlocked NPC approach.
			-- Release on the state transition (or the actual new unit below), not
			-- that older snapshot. Same-ID holding can still confirm real arrival.
			if self.state.outgoing ~= intent.pendingBattleId or self.state.armyState == "Home" then intent.deferred = false end
		end
		if self:IsSelected(pet) then intent.selectedOnce = true
		elseif intent.selectedOnce then
			-- A better later roll can supersede a recruit before it arrives.
			self.recruitIntents[id] = nil;continue
		end
		if pet.home and not intent.homeAcknowledged and not intent.deferred then
			local model = self.base:HomePet(id)
			if model and model:IsA("Model") and model.PrimaryPart then
				intent.homeAcknowledged = true
				self.base:PulseModel(model, C.gold)
			end
		end
	end
end

function AppController:ObserveRecruitUnit(battle, unit, model)
	local intent = unit.petId and self.recruitIntents[unit.petId]
	local state = self.state
	if not intent or not state or state.outgoing ~= battle.id then return end
	local side = if battle.attacker == state.userId then "A" elseif battle.defender == state.userId then "B" else nil
	if not side or unit.side ~= side or not model or not model.PrimaryPart then return end
	if intent.deferred and battle.rosterLocked then return end
	if battle.phase ~= "Fight" and battle.phase ~= "Capture" and battle.phase ~= "Holding" then return end
	if (unit.hp or 0) <= 0 or unit.reinforcing or unit.retiring then return end
	local pet = self:Pet(unit.petId)
	if not pet or not self:IsSelected(pet) then return end
	intent.selectedOnce = true
	-- Both authoritative coordinates and the displayed rig must be at the site.
	local radius = battle.captureRadius or Config.CaptureRadius
	local position = model.PrimaryPart.Position
	if (unit.x - battle.x)^2 + (unit.z - battle.z)^2 > radius^2
		or (position.X - battle.x)^2 + (position.Z - battle.z)^2 > radius^2 then return end
	if intent.battleId ~= battle.id then
		intent.battleId = battle.id
		intent.pendingBattleId = nil
		intent.deferred = false
	end
	if not intent.arrivalAcknowledged then
		intent.arrivalAcknowledged = true
		self.base:PulseModel(model, C.blue)
		if os.clock() - (self.lastRecruitArrivalNotice or -10) > 1.2 then
			self.lastRecruitArrivalNotice = os.clock()
			self:Notify((Catalog[pet.species] and Catalog[pet.species].name or "Chicken") .. " joined your army", true)
		end
	end
	if not intent.contributionAcknowledged and (unit.impactSerial or 0) > 0 then
		-- This may be the first replicated view after a hit already occurred. A
		-- quiet bird emphasis confirms it; never replay that old hit or sound.
		intent.contributionAcknowledged = true
		self.base:PulseModel(model, C.gold)
		self.recruitIntents[unit.petId] = nil
	end
end

function AppController:SelectPet(id)
	self.selected, self.confirm = id, nil
	self:OpenPage("Army")
end

-- One client-owned blur shared by main pages and the separate offline receipt.
function AppController:SetMenuBlur(owner, visible)
	self.menuBlurOwners[owner] = if visible then true else nil
	if not self.alive then return end
	local target = if next(self.menuBlurOwners) then 18 else 0
	if not self.menuBlur then
		if target == 0 then return end
		local blur = Instance.new("BlurEffect")
		blur.Name, blur.Size, blur.Parent = "PetRollMenuBlur", 0, Lighting
		self.menuBlur = blur
	end
	if self.menuBlurTarget == target then return end
	self.menuBlurTarget = target
	local blur = self.menuBlur
	blur.Enabled = true
	Theme.Motion:Tween(blur,"menu-blur",{Size=target},0.24,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.Out,function()
		if self.menuBlurTarget == 0 then blur.Enabled = false end
	end)
end

function AppController:OpenPage(page)
	if page=="Recruits" then page="Odds" end -- Older UI callbacks cannot reopen the removed selector.
	if page=="Sell" then page="Army" end -- Legacy navigation uses the Army inspector.
	if page=="Merge" and not self.mergeBrowser then return end
	self:SetMenuBlur("main",true)
	self.offlineCash:Dismiss(true)
	if self.mergeBrowser and self.page=="Merge" and page~="Merge" then self.mergeBrowser:Close() end
	local switching=self.panel.Visible and not self.panelClosing
	self.panelClosing=false
	if not self.panel.Visible then self.previousSelection=GuiService.SelectedObject end
	self.page = page
	if page=="Merge" and self.mergeBrowser then self.mergeBrowser:Reset() end
	if page=="Shop" then self.commerce:Open() end
	if page=="Army" then self.chickenBrowser:OpenInventory() end
	local tint=Theme.HeaderColors[page] or Theme.ActionColors.navigation
	Theme.SetHeaderColor(self.panelHeader,tint)
	Theme.Surface(self.panelBody,Theme.PageSurfaces[page] or C.panel)
	self.content.ScrollBarImageColor3=tint
	local icon=self.panelHeader.PageIcon
	icon.Visible=page=="Army" or page=="Upgrades" or page=="Odds" or page=="Merge" or page=="Shop" or page=="Index"
	icon.Image=if page=="Shop" then Theme.Assets.Shop elseif page=="Index" then Theme.Assets.Index
		elseif page=="Army" or page=="Merge" then Theme.Assets.Army else Theme.Assets.Luck
	self.panelTitle.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(if icon.Visible then 104 else 24,0)
	self.panelTitle.Size=UDim2.new(1,if icon.Visible then -204 else -132,1,0)
	self.panel.Visible, self.backdrop.Visible = true, true
	self:RenderPanel(true)
	Theme.Motion:OpenPanel(self.panel,self.backdrop,switching)
	if self.toastFrame.Visible then Theme.Motion:Toast(self.toastFrame,true,self:NoticePosition()) end
	if UserInputService.GamepadEnabled then GuiService.SelectedObject=if page=="Upgrades" then self.progression.closeButton elseif page=="Merge" and self.mergeBrowser then self.mergeBrowser.closeButton else self.closeButton end
	ContextActionService:BindActionAtPriority("PetRollClosePanel",function(_,state)
		if state==Enum.UserInputState.Begin then self:ClosePanel() end
		return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
	end,false,2500,Enum.KeyCode.ButtonB)
end

function AppController:ClosePanel()
	if not self.panel.Visible or self.panelClosing then return end
	self.panelClosing=true
	self:SetMenuBlur("main",false)
	if self.page=="Merge" and self.mergeBrowser then self.mergeBrowser:Close() end
	ContextActionService:UnbindAction("PetRollClosePanel")
	if GuiService.SelectedObject and GuiService.SelectedObject:IsDescendantOf(self.panel) then
		GuiService.SelectedObject=if self.previousSelection and self.previousSelection.Parent then self.previousSelection else nil
	end
	Theme.Motion:ClosePanel(self.panel,self.backdrop,function()
		self.panelClosing=false
		if self.toastFrame.Visible then Theme.Motion:Toast(self.toastFrame,true,self:NoticePosition()) end
	end)
	self.confirm = nil
end

function AppController:TogglePage(page)
	self.audio:Play("Click")
	if self.panel.Visible and not self.panelClosing and self.page == page then self:ClosePanel() else self:OpenPage(page) end
end

function AppController:BuildUI()
	Theme.Motion:Reset()
	Theme.Motion:SetReduced(self.reducedMotion)
	local playerGui = Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
	-- Reuse the sole StarterGui template instead of adding another ScreenGui.
	local gui=playerGui:WaitForChild("PetRollGui")
	assert(gui:IsA("ScreenGui"),"PetRollGui must be a ScreenGui")
	local oldShell=gui:FindFirstChild("Shell")
	if oldShell then oldShell:Destroy() end
	gui.Name, gui.ResetOnSpawn, gui.ZIndexBehavior = "PetRollGui", false, Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
	-- The backdrop covers the viewport; the HUD reserves horizontal space for Roblox controls.
	gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
	gui.ScreenInsets = Enum.ScreenInsets.DeviceSafeInsets
	gui.SafeAreaCompatibility = Enum.SafeAreaCompatibility.None
	gui.ClipToDeviceSafeArea = false
	gui.DisplayOrder, gui.Parent = 5, playerGui
	self.gui = gui
	local shell = Theme.Container(gui,"Shell")
	-- Match Example's screen-level organization. Each layer owns one coordinate
	-- space; opening a menu cannot resize the HUD or transient notifications.
	local hudLayer=Theme.Container(shell,"HUD")
	local frames=Theme.Container(shell,"FRAMES");frames.ZIndex=10
	local other=Theme.Container(shell,"OTHER");other.ZIndex=20
	self.hudLayer,self.frames,self.other=hudLayer,frames,other
	-- Keep screen coordinates in rendered pixels; each menu owns its content layout.
	self.hud=HudController.new(self,hudLayer)
	local backdrop=Theme.Frame(frames,"Backdrop",UDim2.fromScale(1,1),C.dark)
	backdrop.BackgroundTransparency,backdrop.Visible,backdrop.Active=1,false,true
	backdrop.ZIndex,self.backdrop=10,backdrop
	Theme.Round(backdrop,0)
	local panel=Theme.Frame(frames,"Panel",UDim2.fromOffset(1120,660))
	panel.BackgroundTransparency=1
	panel.AnchorPoint,panel.Position,panel.Visible=Vector2.new(0.5,0.5),UDim2.fromScale(0.5,0.5),false
	panel.ZIndex,panel.Active,self.panel=11,true,panel
	self.panelMotionScale=Theme.Motion:Scale(panel)
	local standardPage=Theme.Container(panel,"StandardPage")
	self.standardPage=standardPage
	local body=Theme.Frame(standardPage,"Main",UDim2.new(1,0,1,-96))
	body.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,96)
	Theme.Surface(body)
	self.panelBody=body
	self.panelHeader,self.panelTitle=Theme.Header(standardPage,"Header","Your Chickens!",Theme.HeaderColors.Army)
	local close=Theme.ActionButton(self.panelHeader,"Close","X",function() self.audio:Play("Click");self:ClosePanel() end,Theme.Arcade.red)
	close.Position,close.Size,close.TextSize=UDim2.new(1,-84,0,0),UDim2.fromOffset(84,84),60
	self.closeButton=close
	local content=Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
	content.Name,content.Position,content.Size="Content",UDim2.fromOffset(20,18),UDim2.new(1,-40,1,-38)
	content.BackgroundTransparency,content.BorderSizePixel,content.ZIndex=1,0,2
	content.ScrollBarThickness,content.ScrollBarImageColor3=6,Theme.Arcade.green
	content.VerticalScrollBarInset=Enum.ScrollBarInset.Always
	content.AutomaticCanvasSize,content.CanvasSize,content.Parent=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,UDim2.new(),body
	local padding=Instance.new("UIPadding")
	padding.PaddingLeft,padding.PaddingTop,padding.PaddingBottom=UDim.new(0,6),UDim.new(0,5),UDim.new(0,10)
	padding.Parent=content
	self.content=content
	local list=Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	list.Padding,list.SortOrder,list.Parent=UDim.new(0,12),Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,content
	self.contentLayout=list
	self.chickenBrowser=ChickenBrowser.new(self,panel)
	self.mergeBrowser=if MergeBrowser then MergeBrowser.new(self,panel) else nil
	self.shopBrowser=ShopBrowser.new(self,panel)
	self.indexBrowser=IndexBrowser.new(self,body)
	self.progression:Mount(panel)
	table.insert(self.connections,list:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"):Connect(function() self:FitPanel() end))
	self.toastFrame,self.toast=Theme.Notification(other)
	local function resize()
		local available=gui.AbsoluteSize
		if available.X<=0 or available.Y<=0 then return end
		local width,height=available.X,available.Y
		self.uiScale=1
		self.panelMaxHeight=math.min(740,height-24)
		self.panelMaxWidth=math.min(1120,width-24)
		self:FitPanel()
		self.hud:Resize(width,height,1)
		self:SizeNotice()
		if self.toastFrame.Visible then Theme.Motion:Toast(self.toastFrame,true,self:NoticePosition(),true) end
		if self.state and self.panel.Visible then self:RenderPanel(true) end
	end
	table.insert(self.connections,gui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(resize))
	resize()
end

function AppController:FitPanel()
	if not self.contentLayout or not self.panelMaxHeight then return end
	local available=self.gui.AbsoluteSize
	if available.X<=0 or available.Y<=0 then return end
	-- Leave more world visible around menus; small screens keep their readable reflow.
	local popupSize=if available.X>=900 and available.Y>=550 then DESKTOP_POPUP_SIZE else 1
	local width=math.min(self.panelMaxWidth,available.X*0.94)*popupSize
	local height=math.min(self.panelMaxHeight,available.Y*0.92)*popupSize
	if self.page=="Army" then
		-- Keep the Figma window's proportions so the inspector footer fits on desktop.
		self.armyCompact=available.X<900 or available.Y<550
		if not self.armyCompact then
			local fit=math.min(1.1,(available.X-24)/1474,available.X*0.96/1474,
				(available.Y-24)/976,available.Y*0.94/976)*popupSize
			width,height=1474*fit,976*fit
		end
	elseif self.page=="Shop" then
		width=math.min(1080*popupSize,width)
	elseif self.page=="Upgrades" then
		height=math.min(660*popupSize,height)
	elseif self.page=="Merge" then
		if available.X>=900 and available.Y>=550 then
			local fit=math.min(1.1,available.X*0.94/900,available.Y*0.92/850)*popupSize
			width,height=900*fit,850*fit
		end
	elseif self.page~="Index" then
		width=math.min(760*popupSize,width)
		local motion=math.max(self.panelMotionScale.Scale,0.01)
		local contentHeight=self.contentLayout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y/motion
		height=math.min(height,math.max(300,math.ceil(contentHeight)+94))
	end
	self.panelWidth,self.panelHeight=width,height
	self.panel.Size=UDim2.fromScale(width/available.X,height/available.Y)
	Theme.Aspect(self.panel,if self.page=="Army" and not self.armyCompact then 1474/976
		elseif self.page=="Merge" and available.X>=900 and available.Y>=550 then 900/850 else nil)
	-- Shared Index/Settings/Odds shell: fixed readable header, flexible scrolling body.
	self.panelHeader.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,60)
	self.panelHeader.PageIcon.Size,self.panelHeader.PageIcon.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(48,48),UDim2.fromOffset(8,6)
	self.panelTitle.TextSize=32
	self.panelTitle.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(if self.panelHeader.PageIcon.Visible then 64 else 16,0)
	self.panelTitle.Size=UDim2.new(1,if self.panelHeader.PageIcon.Visible then -128 else -80,1,0)
	self.closeButton.Size,self.closeButton.Position,self.closeButton.TextSize=UDim2.fromOffset(52,52),UDim2.new(1,-56,0,4),32
	self.panelBody.Position,self.panelBody.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(0,68),UDim2.new(1,0,1,-68)
	self.content.Position,self.content.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(12,12),UDim2.new(1,-24,1,-24)

function AppController:Counts()
	local state = self.state or {}
	local count = state.count or #(state.pets or {})
	local capacity = state.capacity or Config.StartingSlots
	local selected = state.selectedCount
	if selected == nil then selected = if state.selectedIds then #state.selectedIds else math.min(count, capacity) end
	local deployed = state.deployedCount
	if deployed == nil then
		deployed = if state.deployedIds then #state.deployedIds elseif state.armyState and state.armyState ~= "Home" then state.deployed or 0 else 0
	end
	return count, state.collectionLimit or Config.CollectionLimit, capacity, selected, deployed
end

function AppController:PetIncome(pet)
	if type(pet.income) == "number" then return pet.income end
	return Rules.Income(pet.species,pet.stars or 1,pet.level,self.state.incomeLevel or 0)
end

function AppController:IsSelected(pet)
	if pet.selected ~= nil then return pet.selected == true end
	if self.state.selectedIds then return table.find(self.state.selectedIds, pet.id) ~= nil end
	return pet.slot ~= nil
end

function AppController:IsDeployed(pet)
	if pet.deployed ~= nil then return pet.deployed == true end
	if self.state.deployedIds then return table.find(self.state.deployedIds, pet.id) ~= nil end
	return self.state.armyState ~= "Home" and pet.slot ~= nil
end

function AppController:Groups()
	local groups, byKey = {}, {}
	for _, pet in self.state.pets or {} do
		local key = groupKey(pet)
		local group = byKey[key]
		if not group then
			group = {key = key, species = pet.species, stars = pet.stars, level = pet.level or 1, pets = {}, sellable = {}, ready = 0, deployed = 0, favorites = 0, income = 0}
			byKey[key] = group;table.insert(groups, group)
		end
		table.insert(group.pets, pet)
		if self:IsSelected(pet) then group.ready += 1 end
		if self:IsDeployed(pet) then group.deployed += 1 end
		if pet.canSell == true then table.insert(group.sellable, pet) end
		if pet.favorite then group.favorites += 1;group.favorite = group.favorite or pet end
		group.income += self:PetIncome(pet)
	end
	for _, group in groups do
		table.sort(group.sellable, function(a, b) return a.id < b.id end)
		group.representative = group.sellable[1] or group.favorite or group.pets[1]
		group.protected = #group.pets - #group.sellable
	end
	table.sort(groups, function(a, b)
		local ap, bp = Rules.PetPower(a.species, a.stars, a.level), Rules.PetPower(b.species, b.stars, b.level)
		if ap ~= bp then return ap > bp end
		return a.key < b.key
	end)
	return groups, byKey
end

function AppController:RenderPanel(force)
	if not self.state or not self.panel.Visible then return end
	local browsing=self.page=="Army"
	local merging=self.page=="Merge" and self.mergeBrowser~=nil
	local shopping,indexing=self.page=="Shop",self.page=="Index"
	local upgrading=self.page=="Upgrades"
	self.progression.root.Visible=upgrading
	self.content.Visible,self.chickenBrowser.root.Visible=not browsing and not merging and not shopping and not indexing and not upgrading,browsing
	if self.mergeBrowser then self.mergeBrowser.root.Visible=merging end
	self.panelHeader.Visible,self.panelBody.Visible=not shopping and not browsing and not upgrading and not merging,not shopping and not browsing and not upgrading and not merging
	self.standardPage.Visible=not shopping and not browsing and not upgrading and not merging
	self.shopBrowser.root.Visible,self.indexBrowser.root.Visible=shopping,indexing
	if upgrading then
		self:FitPanel();self.progression:Render();return
	end
	if shopping then
		self.panelTitle.Text="Shop!";self:FitPanel();self.shopBrowser:Render(force);return
	end
	if indexing then
		self.panelTitle.Text="Chicken Index!";self:FitPanel();self.indexBrowser:Render(force);return
	end
	if merging then
		self.panelTitle.Text="Fuse Chickens"
		self:FitPanel();self.mergeBrowser:Render(force)
		return
	end
	if browsing then
		self.panelTitle.Text="Your Chickens!"
		self:FitPanel()
		self.chickenBrowser:Render(force)
		return
	end
	local state = self.state
	local keys = {self.page, tostring(self.selected), tostring(self.confirm), tostring(state.capacity), tostring(state.luck), tostring(state.incomeLevel), state.armyState, tostring(state.campsWon),tostring(state.incoming)}
	local p=state.progression
	if p then table.insert(keys,p.rank..":"..p.recruitTier..":"..tostring(p.goal)..":"..tostring(p.requirement)..":"..tostring(state.kingCleared)) end

		table.insert(keys, tostring(state.shop and state.shop.testAllowed))
		table.insert(keys, tostring(state.shop and state.shop.testPreset))
	end

	self.panelKey = key

		self.panelTitle.Text = "Roll Odds"
		for _, id in Catalog.Order do

			if chance and chance > 0 then self:Text("Odds"..id, Catalog[id].name.." · "..Rules.FormatOdds(chance),15,30) end

function AppController:Receive(packet)
	if type(packet) ~= "table" or type(packet.state) ~= "table" then return end
	local old = self.state
	self.state = packet.state
	local state = self.state
	self.eggs:Receive(state.eggs)
	if not old or old.plotIndex ~= state.plotIndex then self.base:RefreshPromptOwnership() end
	if self.selected and not self:Pet(self.selected) then
		local previous
		for _, pet in (old and old.pets) or {} do if pet.id == self.selected then previous = pet;break end end
		self.selected, self.confirm = nil, nil
		if previous then
			local _, byKey = self:Groups()
			local group = byKey[groupKey(previous)]
			if group then self.selected = group.representative.id end
		end
	end
	local result = packet.result
	if result and not self.mergeBrowser and (result.action=="OpenMerge" or result.action=="Merge" or result.action=="MergeAll") then result=nil end
	local shownRecruit, newRecruit = false, false
	local shownProduction,newProduction=false,false
	if result then shownProduction,newProduction=self:TrackProductionUpgrade(result) end
	self.chickenBrowser:Receive(result)
	if self.mergeBrowser then self.mergeBrowser:Receive(result) end
	self.commerce:Receive(result)
	self.progression:Receive(result)
	self.upgradeBoard:Receive(result)
	self.eggBoard:Receive(result)
	if result and result.action~="RefreshShop" and result.action~="PreparePurchase" then
		local shownInMerge=result.action=="OpenMerge" or ((result.action=="Merge" or result.action=="MergeAll") and self.page=="Merge" and self.panel.Visible)
  if result.ok and result.action=="Buy" then shownRecruit,newRecruit=self:TrackRecruit(result) end
  if not shownProduction and not (result.ok and (result.action=="Roll" or shownInMerge or shownRecruit)) then self:Notify(result.message,result.ok) end
		if result.ok and result.action == "Buy" and not shownRecruit then self.feedback:Action("Buy");self.base:PetPulse(result.petId, C.gold) end
		if result.ok and (result.action == "Sell" or result.action == "Promote") then self.feedback:Action(result.action) end
		if result.ok and result.action == "OpenMerge" then self:OpenPage("Merge") end
		if result.ok and (result.action == "Merge" or result.action == "MergeAll") then
			self.base:PetPulse(result.petId,C.gold)
		end
		if result.ok and (result.action == "Income" or result.action == "Luck" or result.action == "Expand")
			and (not shownProduction or newProduction) then self.feedback:Action(result.action) end
		if result.ok and result.action == "Attack" then self:ClosePanel() end
	end
	local count, limit, capacity, selectedCount, deployedCount = self:Counts()
	self.hud:Update(state, count, limit, capacity, selectedCount, deployedCount)
	self.base:UpdateObjective()
	self:StepRecruitFeedback()
	if state.banner and state.banner ~= "" and state.banner ~= self.lastBanner then self:Notify(state.banner);self.lastBanner = state.banner end
	if old and state.lastResult ~= old.lastResult and not packet.result then self:Notify(state.lastResult) end
	self:RenderPanel(old == nil)
	self.offlineCash:Receive(state)
	if result and result.ok then
		local changed=if (result.action=="Expand" or result.action=="Income" or result.action=="Luck")
			and (not shownProduction or newProduction) then self.progression.row else nil
		if changed then
			local name=if result.action=="Expand" then "Capacity" else result.action
			local card=changed:FindFirstChild(name)
			if card and card:FindFirstChild("Icon") then Theme.Motion:Pop(card.Icon,1.18) end
		end
		-- Keep reward motion local to the action, not behind notification text.
		if result.action=="Sell" then Theme.Motion:Pop(self.hud.cashIcon,1.14) end
	end
end

function AppController:Start()
	self.remotes = ReplicatedStorage.PetRoll:WaitForChild("Remotes")
	self:BuildUI()
	self.upgradeBoard:Start()
	self.eggBoard:Start()
	self.audio:Start()
	self.feedback:Start()
	self.commerce:Start()
	self.eggs:Start()
	self.animator = DuckAnimator.new()

	self.prompts=PromptStyleController.new(self)
	self.prompts:Start()
	self.base:Start()
	self.battle:Start(self.remotes:WaitForChild("BattleChanged"))
	table.insert(self.connections, self.remotes:WaitForChild("StateChanged").OnClientEvent:Connect(function(packet) self:Receive(packet) end))
	for _, entry in {{"Army", Enum.KeyCode.B}, {"Upgrades", Enum.KeyCode.U}, {"Settings", Enum.KeyCode.O}, {"Test", Enum.KeyCode.F8}} do
		local page, key = entry[1], entry[2]
		ContextActionService:BindAction("PetRoll" .. page, function(_, inputState)
			if inputState ~= Enum.UserInputState.Begin or UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass end
			if page == "Test" and (not self.state or not self.state.debugAllowed) then return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass end
			self:TogglePage(page)
			return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
		end, false, key)
	end
	table.insert(self.connections, UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Escape and self.panel.Visible then self:ClosePanel() end
	end))
	self:Request("Sync")
	print("[PetRoll] My Chicken Army! client ready")
end

function AppController:Destroy()
	self.alive = false
	if self.toastDelay then task.cancel(self.toastDelay);self.toastDelay=nil end
	Theme.Motion:Reset()
	ContextActionService:UnbindAction("PetRollClosePanel")
	for _, connection in self.connections do connection:Disconnect() end
	for _, page in {"Army", "Upgrades", "Settings", "Test"} do ContextActionService:UnbindAction("PetRoll" .. page) end
	if self.animator then self.animator:Destroy() end
	if self.prompts then self.prompts:Destroy() end

	if self.mergeBrowser then self.mergeBrowser:Destroy() end
	self.progression:Destroy()
	self.upgradeBoard:Destroy()
	self.eggBoard:Destroy()
	self.offlineCash:Destroy()

	self.recruitIntents,self.recruitReceipts={},{}

end

--!strict
-- Discovery remains server-owned. This browser only presents the approved roster.
local Theme=require(script.Parent.UITheme)
local Shared=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").PetRoll.Shared
local Catalog=require(Shared.PetCatalog)
local C=Theme.Colors
local Browser={}
Browser.__index=Browser

local GAP=14
local REST=UDim2.fromScale(0.5,0.5)
local WHITE=Color3.new(1,1,1)
local BLACK=Color3.new(0,0,0)

local function previewPosition(collected)
	return if collected then UDim2.fromOffset(9,8) else UDim2.fromOffset(9,9)
end

function Browser.new(app,parent)
	local self=setmetatable({
		app=app,parent=parent,cards={},connections={},pending={},alive=true,opened=false,columns=4,
	},Browser)
	local root=Theme.Frame(parent,"IndexBrowser",UDim2.new(1,-24,1,-24))
	root.Position,root.BackgroundTransparency,root.Visible=UDim2.fromOffset(12,12),1,false
	root:SetAttribute("OwnsPopupStyle",true)
	self.root=root

	-- One scrolling collection, no filters, selection controls, or information on missing birds.
	local grid=Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
	grid.Name,grid.Position,grid.Size="IndexGrid",UDim2.new(),UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
	grid.BackgroundTransparency,grid.BorderSizePixel,grid.ScrollBarThickness=1,0,6
	grid.ScrollBarImageColor3=Theme.ActionColors.navigation
	grid.AutomaticCanvasSize,grid.CanvasSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,UDim2.new()
	grid.ScrollingDirection,grid.VerticalScrollBarInset=Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y,Enum.ScrollBarInset.Always
	grid.ClipsDescendants,grid.Parent=true,root
	local padding=Instance.new("UIPadding")
	padding.PaddingLeft,padding.PaddingRight=UDim.new(0,10),UDim.new(0,14)
	padding.PaddingTop,padding.PaddingBottom=UDim.new(0,8),UDim.new(0,12)
	padding.Parent=grid
	local layout=Instance.new("UIGridLayout")
	layout.CellSize,layout.CellPadding=UDim2.fromOffset(248,248),UDim2.fromOffset(GAP,GAP)
	layout.SortOrder,layout.HorizontalAlignment=Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
	layout.Parent=grid
	self.grid,self.layout=grid,layout

	table.insert(self.connections,grid:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(function() self:Resize() end))
	table.insert(self.connections,root:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function() self:SyncVisibility() end))
	table.insert(self.connections,parent:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function() self:SyncVisibility() end))
	table.insert(self.connections,app.panel:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function() self:SyncVisibility() end))
	self:Resize()
	return self
end

function Browser:BuildCards()
	if next(self.cards) then return end
	for i,species in Catalog.Order do
		local slot=Theme.Frame(self.grid,"Entry_"..i,UDim2.fromOffset(248,248))
		slot.LayoutOrder,slot.BackgroundTransparency=i,1
		local visual=Theme.Frame(slot,"Visual",UDim2.new(1,-6,1,-6),WHITE)
		visual.Position,visual.AnchorPoint,visual.ClipsDescendants=REST,Vector2.new(0.5,0.5),true
		Theme.Stroke(visual,Theme.Arcade.border,3)
		local scale=Theme.Motion:Scale(visual)
		local studs=Theme.Studs(visual,0.15,32,3)
		local inset=Theme.Frame(visual,"InnerRim",UDim2.new(1,-8,1,-8))
		inset.Position,inset.BackgroundTransparency,inset.ZIndex=UDim2.fromOffset(4,4),1,4
		local rim=Theme.Stroke(inset,C.white,1)
		rim.Transparency=0.42
		local preview=self.app:Preview(visual,{species=species,stars=1,level=1},
			UDim2.new(1,-18,1,-64),previewPosition(true))
		preview.ImageColor3,preview.ImageTransparency=BLACK,0

		-- Reserve a separate bottom strip so even two-line names never cross the chicken.
		local caption=Theme.Frame(visual,"Caption",UDim2.new(1,-10,0,48),WHITE)
		caption.Position,caption.AnchorPoint,caption.ZIndex=UDim2.new(0,5,1,-5),Vector2.new(0,1),4
		local gradient=Theme.Gradient(caption,Color3.fromRGB(14,20,24),Color3.fromRGB(5,9,12))
		gradient.Transparency=NumberSequence.new(0.22,0.06)
		local name=Theme.Label(caption,"Name","",24,C.white)
		name.Position,name.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(6,2),UDim2.new(1,-12,1,-4)
		name.TextXAlignment,name.TextYAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
		name.TextScaled=true
		local textLimit=Instance.new("UITextSizeConstraint")
		textLimit.MinTextSize,textLimit.MaxTextSize,textLimit.Parent=18,24,name
		caption.Visible=false
		local view={root=slot,visual=visual,scale=scale,preview=preview,caption=caption,
			name=name,rim=rim,studs=studs,collected=nil}
		self.cards[species]=view

		local function hover(active)
			if not self.alive or not self.opened then return end
			local moving=active and not Theme.Motion.reduced
			Theme.Motion:Tween(scale,"index-scale",{Scale=if moving then 1.018 else 1},0.15)
			Theme.Motion:Tween(preview,"index-lift",{
				Position=previewPosition(view.collected==true)+UDim2.fromOffset(0,if moving then -4 else 0),
			},0.17)
			Theme.Motion:Tween(rim,"index-highlight",{Transparency=if active then 0.1 else 0.42},0.15)
		end
		table.insert(self.connections,visual.MouseEnter:Connect(function() hover(true) end))
		table.insert(self.connections,visual.MouseLeave:Connect(function() hover(false) end))
	end
end

function Browser:Resize()
	if not self.alive then return end
	-- Cancel the outer popup's animated scale when measuring the logical grid.
	local motionScale=self.app.panelMotionScale and self.app.panelMotionScale.Scale or 1
	local scale=math.max((self.app.uiScale or 1)*motionScale,0.01)
	local width=math.floor(self.grid.AbsoluteSize.X/scale+0.5)-30
	if width<=0 then return end
	local columns=math.clamp(math.floor((width+GAP)/(if width<500 then 156 else 224)),1,4)
	local cellWidth=math.max(1,math.floor((width-GAP*(columns-1))/columns))
	self.columns=columns
	self.layout.CellSize=UDim2.fromOffset(cellWidth,cellWidth)
	self.layout.FillDirectionMaxCells=columns
end

function Browser:StopMotion()
	for thread in self.pending do task.cancel(thread) end
	table.clear(self.pending)
	for _,view in self.cards do
		Theme.Motion:Cancel(view.scale,"index-scale")
		Theme.Motion:Cancel(view.visual,"index-enter")
		Theme.Motion:Cancel(view.preview,"index-lift")
		Theme.Motion:Cancel(view.rim,"index-highlight")
		view.scale.Scale,view.visual.Position,view.rim.Transparency=1,REST,0.42
		view.preview.Position=previewPosition(view.collected==true)
		local shine=view.visual:FindFirstChild("MotionShine")
		if shine then
			local gradient=shine:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UIGradient")
			if gradient then Theme.Motion:Cancel(gradient,"shine") end
			shine.Visible=false
		end
	end
end

function Browser:Reveal()
	self:StopMotion()
	if Theme.Motion.reduced then return end
	local top,bottom=self.grid.AbsolutePosition.Y,self.grid.AbsolutePosition.Y+self.grid.AbsoluteSize.Y
	local order=0
	for _,species in Catalog.Order do
		local view=self.cards[species]
		local y=view.root.AbsolutePosition.Y
		if y+view.root.AbsoluteSize.Y>=top and y<bottom then
			view.scale.Scale,view.visual.Position=0.91,REST+UDim2.fromOffset(0,10)
			local thread
			thread=task.delay(math.min(order*0.035,0.24),function()
				self.pending[thread]=nil
				if not self.alive or not self.opened then return end
				Theme.Motion:Tween(view.scale,"index-scale",{Scale=1},0.28,Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
				Theme.Motion:Tween(view.visual,"index-enter",{Position=REST},0.24)
			end)
			self.pending[thread]=true
			order+=1
		end
	end
end

function Browser:SyncVisibility()
	if not self.alive then return end
	local visible=self.root.Visible and self.parent.Visible and self.app.panel.Visible and self.app.page=="Index"
	if visible and not next(self.cards) then return end
	if visible==self.opened then return end
	self.opened=visible
	if visible then self:Resize();self:Reveal() else self:StopMotion() end
end

function Browser:Render(_force)
	local state=self.app.state
	if not state or not self.alive then return end
	self:BuildCards()
	self:Resize()
	-- Apply the approved cyan header only to this page, without changing the shared palette.
	Theme.ApplyReferenceAccent(self.app.panelHeader,Theme.ReferenceGradients.Upgrades)
	local discovered={}
	for _,pet in state.pets or {} do
		if self.cards[pet.species] then discovered[pet.species]=true end
	end
	if type(state.discovered)=="table" then
		for _,species in Catalog.Order do
			if state.discovered[species]==true then discovered[species]=true end
		end
	end
	for _,species in Catalog.Order do
		local view=self.cards[species]
		local collected=discovered[species]==true
		if view.collected~=collected then
			local newlyCollected=view.collected==false and collected
			view.collected=collected
			view.root:SetAttribute("Collected",collected)
			view.caption.Visible=collected
			view.name.Text=if collected then Catalog[species].name else ""
			view.preview.ImageColor3=if collected then WHITE else BLACK
			view.preview.Position=previewPosition(collected)
			view.preview.Size=if collected then UDim2.new(1,-18,1,-64) else UDim2.new(1,-18,1,-18)
			if collected then
				local color=Theme.Rarities[Catalog[species].rarity] or Theme.ActionColors.navigation
				Theme.Gradient(view.visual,color:Lerp(WHITE,0.27),color:Lerp(Theme.Arcade.border,0.36))
				view.rim.Color=color:Lerp(WHITE,0.65)
				view.studs.ImageTransparency=0.82
			else
				Theme.Gradient(view.visual,Color3.fromRGB(117,131,136),Color3.fromRGB(67,78,85))
				view.rim.Color=Color3.fromRGB(176,194,201)
				view.studs.ImageTransparency=0.91
			end
			if newlyCollected and self.opened and not Theme.Motion.reduced then
				view.scale.Scale=0.94
				Theme.Motion:Tween(view.scale,"index-scale",{Scale=1},0.32,Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
				Theme.Motion:Shine(view.visual)
			end
		end
	end
	self:SyncVisibility()
end

function Browser:Destroy()
	self.alive,self.opened=false,false
	self:StopMotion()
	for _,connection in self.connections do connection:Disconnect() end
	table.clear(self.connections)
	self.root:Destroy()
	table.clear(self.cards)
end

return Browser

--!strict
-- Displays an already-saved server receipt; dismissal never grants currency.
local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")
local ContextActionService = game:GetService("ContextActionService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TextService = game:GetService("TextService")
local Theme = require(script.Parent.UITheme)
local Controller = {}
Controller.__index = Controller
local GREEN = Theme.ReferenceColors.Army
local EDGE = 8 -- Keep outlines and button motion inside the fading canvas.

local function fitSingleLine(item, width, maximum, minimum)
	item.TextScaled,item.TextWrapped=false,false
	local size=math.max(minimum,maximum)
	while size>minimum and TextService:GetTextSize(item.Text,size,item.Font,Vector2.new(100000,100000)).X>width-8 do
		size-=1
	end
	item.TextSize=size
end

function Controller.new(app)
	return setmetatable({app=app,seen=nil,connections={}},Controller)
end

function Controller:Dismiss(immediate)
	local gui,panel=self.gui,self.panel
	if not gui or (self.closing and not immediate) then return end
	self.closing=true
	ContextActionService:UnbindAction("PetRollOfflineCashClose")
	if GuiService.SelectedObject and GuiService.SelectedObject:IsDescendantOf(gui) then
		GuiService.SelectedObject=if self.previousSelection and self.previousSelection.Parent then self.previousSelection else nil
	end
	for _,connection in self.connections do connection:Disconnect() end
	table.clear(self.connections)
	self.app:SetMenuBlur("offline",false)
	local function finish()
		if self.gui~=gui then return end
		self.gui,self.panel,self.closing=nil,nil,false
		gui:Destroy()
	end
	if immediate then finish();return end
	Theme.Motion:Tween(Theme.Motion:Scale(panel),"scale",{Scale=0.97},0.16,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.In)
	Theme.Motion:Tween(panel,"position",{Position=UDim2.new(0.5,0,0.5,12)},0.16)
	Theme.Motion:Tween(panel,"receipt-fade",{GroupTransparency=1},0.16,nil,nil,finish)
end

function Controller:Receive(state)
	local reward=state.offlineCash
	if not reward or reward.amount<=0 or reward.id==self.seen then return end
	self.seen=reward.id
	self:Dismiss(true)
	-- Acquire before closing the main panel so its exit cannot clear our blur.
	self.app:SetMenuBlur("offline",true)
	self.app:ClosePanel()
	self.previousSelection=GuiService.SelectedObject
	local gui=Theme.InsetContainer(self.app.other,"OfflineEarnings",Enum.ScreenInsets.CoreUISafeInsets)
	gui.ZIndex=30
	self.gui,self.closing=gui,false
	local frames=Theme.Container(gui,"FRAMES")
	local backdrop=Theme.Frame(frames,"Backdrop",UDim2.fromScale(1,1))
	backdrop.BackgroundTransparency,backdrop.Active=1,true
	local panel=Instance.new("CanvasGroup")
	panel.Name,panel.Size="OfflineCash",UDim2.fromOffset(576,456)
	panel.BackgroundTransparency,panel.BorderSizePixel,panel.GroupTransparency=1,0,1
	panel.Active,panel.ZIndex=true,2
	panel.AnchorPoint,panel.Position=Vector2.new(0.5,0.5),UDim2.fromScale(0.5,0.5)
	panel.Parent,self.panel=frames,panel
	local header,title=Theme.Header(panel,"Header","Offline Earnings",GREEN)
	title.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
	title.TextShadow.Visible=false
	Theme.Stroke(header,Theme.Arcade.border,3)
	local main=Theme.Container(panel,"Main")
	local actions=Theme.Container(main,"Actions")
	actions.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(0,1)
	local body=Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
	body.Name,body.BackgroundTransparency,body.BorderSizePixel="Content",1,0
	body.AutomaticCanvasSize,body.CanvasSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,UDim2.new()
	body.ScrollingDirection,body.ScrollBarThickness=Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y,3
	body.ScrollBarImageColor3,body.Parent=GREEN,main
	local list=Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	list.SortOrder,list.Parent=Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,body
	local function label(parent,name,value,size,height,color)
		local item=Theme.Label(parent,name,value,size,color)
		item.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,height)
		item.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
		return item
	end
	local hero=Theme.Frame(body,"CashEarned",UDim2.new(1,0,0,224))
	hero.BackgroundTransparency,hero.LayoutOrder=1,1
	local lead=label(hero,"LeadIn","You've earned",30,32)
	local amount=label(hero,"Amount","+$"..Theme.Money(reward.amount),88,120,Color3.new(1,1,1))
	local gradient=Instance.new("UIGradient")
	gradient.Color,gradient.Rotation,gradient.Parent=Theme.ReferenceGradients.Army,90,amount
	local explanation=label(hero,"Explanation","while you were away!",28,30)
	local saved=label(body,"Saved","✓ Added to your cash",24,28,GREEN)
	saved.LayoutOrder=2
	local function close()
		if not self.gui or self.closing then return end
		self.app.audio:Play("Click")
		self:Dismiss()
	end
	local continue=Theme.ActionButton(actions,"Continue","Continue",close,GREEN)
	Theme.Studs(continue.Visual.Face,0.16,28,0)
	continue.Visual.Caption.Position,continue.Visual.Caption.Size=UDim2.new(),UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
	continue.Visual.Caption.TextShadow.Visible=false
	local function resize()
		local available=gui.AbsoluteSize
		if available.X<=0 or available.Y<=0 then return end
		local width,height=math.max(1,math.min(576,available.X-24)),math.max(1,math.min(456,available.Y-24))
		local innerWidth,innerHeight=width-EDGE*2,height-EDGE*2
		local short=innerHeight<390
		local headerHeight=if short then 52 else 64
		local buttonHeight=if short then 52 else 60
		local padding,gap=if short then 12 else 20,if short then 8 else 14
		local contentWidth=math.max(1,innerWidth-padding*2)
		local contentHeight=math.max(1,innerHeight-headerHeight-buttonHeight-padding*3-gap)
		local heroHeight=math.max(124,contentHeight-28-gap)
		local leadHeight,explanationHeight=if short then 26 else 32,if short then 26 else 30
		local amountHeight=heroHeight-leadHeight-explanationHeight-12
		panel.Size=UDim2.fromScale(width/available.X,height/available.Y)
		header.Position,header.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(EDGE,EDGE),UDim2.new(1,-EDGE*2,0,headerHeight)
		title.Position,title.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(12,0),UDim2.new(1,-24,1,0)
		local mainHeight=innerHeight-headerHeight
		Theme.RelativeRect(main,EDGE,EDGE+headerHeight,innerWidth,mainHeight,width,height)
		Theme.RelativeRect(body,padding,padding,contentWidth,contentHeight,innerWidth,mainHeight)
		actions.Position,actions.Size=UDim2.new(0,padding,1,-padding),UDim2.new(1,-padding*2,0,buttonHeight)
		list.Padding=UDim.new(0,gap)
		hero.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,heroHeight)
		lead.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,leadHeight)
		amount.Position,amount.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(0,leadHeight+6),UDim2.new(1,0,0,amountHeight)
		explanation.Position,explanation.Size=UDim2.new(0,0,1,-explanationHeight),UDim2.new(1,0,0,explanationHeight)
		continue.Position,continue.Size=UDim2.new(),UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
		continue.TextSize=if short then 28 else 34
		fitSingleLine(title,innerWidth-24,if short then 32 else 42,22)
		fitSingleLine(lead,contentWidth,if short then 24 else 30,20)
		fitSingleLine(amount,contentWidth-8,math.min(88,amountHeight-8),18)
		fitSingleLine(explanation,contentWidth,if short then 22 else 28,18)
		fitSingleLine(saved,contentWidth,24,18)
		title.TextFace.TextOutline.Thickness=2
		lead.TextOutline.Thickness=1.3
		amount.TextOutline.Thickness=math.min(3,amount.TextSize*0.04)
		explanation.TextOutline.Thickness=1.5
		saved.TextOutline.Thickness=1.2
		continue.Visual.Caption.TextFace.TextOutline.Thickness=1.5
	end
	table.insert(self.connections,gui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(resize))
	resize()
	local scale=Theme.Motion:Scale(panel)
	scale.Scale=if self.app.reducedMotion then 1 else 0.94
	panel.Position=UDim2.new(0.5,0,0.5,if self.app.reducedMotion then 0 else 18)
	Theme.Motion:Tween(scale,"scale",{Scale=1},0.28,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
	Theme.Motion:Tween(panel,"position",{Position=UDim2.fromScale(0.5,0.5)},0.28)
	Theme.Motion:Tween(panel,"receipt-fade",{GroupTransparency=0},0.22)
	ContextActionService:BindActionAtPriority("PetRollOfflineCashClose",function(_,inputState)
		if inputState==Enum.UserInputState.Begin then close() end
		return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
	end,false,3000,Enum.KeyCode.ButtonB)
	table.insert(self.connections,UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.Escape then close() end
	end))
	if UserInputService.GamepadEnabled then GuiService.SelectedObject=continue end
end

function Controller:Destroy()
	self:Dismiss(true)
end

return Controller

-- Opt-in cash affordability feedback for the yard and egg-collection upgrades.
Theme.UnaffordableGradient = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(166,166,166),Color3.fromRGB(92,92,92))
Theme.Assets = {
	Merge = "rbxassetid://122096168414414",
	Cash="rbxassetid://101788696120931", Studs="rbxassetid://93331178043153",
	Rays="rbxassetid://120904904160174", Multiplier="rbxassetid://124712149166140",
	Army="rbxassetid://100291580520125", Luck="rbxassetid://111087925336083",
	ArmyHud="rbxassetid://107457338807219", CallArmy="rbxassetid://125964672530167", MyBase="rbxassetid://76117843071069",
	Shop="rbxassetid://119358432410091", Index="rbxassetid://96489791857751", EggMagnet="rbxassetid://131332157337305",

Theme.Rarities = Palette.Rarities
-- Background-free simulator feedback: bold status-colored text and a clear outline.
Theme.NotificationStyles = {
	success={symbol="✓",color=Color3.fromRGB(112,222,98)},
	error={symbol="×",color=Color3.fromRGB(255,120,132)},
	warning={symbol="!",color=Color3.fromRGB(244,194,71)},
	info={symbol="i",color=Theme.Arcade.blue:Lerp(Palette.Text,0.35)},
	pending={symbol="…",color=Palette.Muted},
}

function Theme.SetNotification(label, text, kind)
	local style=Theme.NotificationStyles[kind] or Theme.NotificationStyles.info
	-- Names remain literal; color the full message so status reads at a glance.
	local escaped=text:gsub("&","&"):gsub("<","<"):gsub(">",">")
	label.TextColor3=style.color
	label.Text=style.symbol.."  "..escaped
	label:SetAttribute("PlainText",style.symbol.."  "..text)
end

function Theme.Round(item, radius)
	local corner = item:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UICorner") or Instance.new("UICorner")
	-- Shared surfaces are square; intentional circular masks override this.
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 0)
	corner.Parent = item
	return corner
end

function Theme.Stroke(item, color, thickness)
	local outline = item:FindFirstChild("UIStroke") or Instance.new("UIStroke")
	outline.Name, outline.Color = "UIStroke", color or Theme.Arcade.border
	outline.Thickness = thickness or 3
	outline.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
	outline.LineJoinMode = Enum.LineJoinMode.Miter
	outline.Parent = item
	return outline
end

function Theme.Gradient(item, top, bottom)
	local gradient = item:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UIGradient") or Instance.new("UIGradient")
	gradient.Color, gradient.Rotation = ColorSequence.new(top, bottom), 90
	gradient.Parent = item
	return gradient
end

function Theme.Frame(parent, name, size, color)
	local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
	frame.Name, frame.Size = name, size
	frame.BackgroundColor3, frame.BorderSizePixel = color or Theme.Colors.paper, 0
	frame.Parent = parent
	Theme.Round(frame)
	return frame
end

-- Structural containers are transparent and fill their parent. They do not own
-- a surface, stroke or animation scale (StarterGui.Example uses the same layers).
function Theme.Container(parent, name)
	local container=Instance.new("Frame")
	container.Name,container.Size=name,UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
	container.BackgroundTransparency,container.BorderSizePixel=1,0
	container.Parent=parent
	return container
end

-- Keep inset-specific overlays inside the one game ScreenGui. GetInsetArea
-- rectangles and AbsolutePosition share the Core UI origin.
function Theme.InsetContainer(parent, name, screenInsets)
	local guiService=game:GetService("GuiService")
	local container=Theme.Container(parent,name)
	local function resize()
		local area=guiService:GetInsetArea(screenInsets)
		local position=area.Min-parent.AbsolutePosition
		local size=area.Max-area.Min
		container.Position,container.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(position.X,position.Y),UDim2.fromOffset(size.X,size.Y)
	end
	local connections={
		parent:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsolutePosition"):Connect(resize),
		parent:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(resize),
		guiService:GetPropertyChangedSignal("TopbarInset"):Connect(resize),
	}
	container.Destroying:Once(function()
		for _,connection in connections do connection:Disconnect() end
	end)
	resize()
	return container
end

function Theme.Aspect(item, ratio)
	local constraint=item:FindFirstChild("LayoutAspect")
	if not ratio then if constraint then constraint:Destroy() end;return end
	constraint=constraint or Instance.new("UIAspectRatioConstraint")
	constraint.Name,constraint.AspectRatio="LayoutAspect",ratio
	constraint.AspectType,constraint.DominantAxis=Enum.AspectType.FitWithinMaxSize,Enum.DominantAxis.Width
	constraint.Parent=item
end

-- Express a designed rectangle in its own parent's coordinate space. Insets and
-- touch targets may remain pixels; artwork/composition must follow the parent.
function Theme.RelativeRect(item,x,y,width,height,parentWidth,parentHeight)
	item.Position=UDim2.fromScale(x/math.max(1,parentWidth),y/math.max(1,parentHeight))
	item.Size=UDim2.fromScale(width/math.max(1,parentWidth),height/math.max(1,parentHeight))
end

function Theme.Image(parent, name, asset, size, position)
	local image = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
	image.Name, image.Image = name, asset
	image.Size, image.Position = size, position or UDim2.new()
	image.BackgroundTransparency, image.ScaleType, image.ZIndex = 1, Enum.ScaleType.Fit, 3
	image.Parent = parent
	return image
end

-- One full-sheet image cropped by a transparent frame; never individual studs.
local studBindings = setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})

function Theme.BindStudTexture(pattern: ImageLabel, spacing: number?)
	local parent=pattern.Parent
	if not parent then return end
	local clip
	if parent:IsA("Frame") and parent:GetAttribute("StudSheetClip")==true then
		clip=parent
	else
		clip=Instance.new("Frame")
		clip.Name="StudClip"
		clip:SetAttribute("StudSheetClip",true)
		clip.Size,clip.Position,clip.AnchorPoint=pattern.Size,pattern.Position,pattern.AnchorPoint
		clip.Rotation,clip.LayoutOrder=pattern.Rotation,pattern.LayoutOrder
		clip.BackgroundTransparency,clip.BorderSizePixel,clip.Active=1,0,false
		clip.ClipsDescendants=true
		clip.Parent=parent
		pattern.Parent=clip
	end
	local pixels=spacing or pattern:GetAttribute("StudSpacing") or pattern.TileSize.X.Offset
	pattern:SetAttribute("StudSpacing",if type(pixels)=="number" and pixels>0 then pixels else 28)
	pattern.Image,pattern.ScaleType=Theme.Assets.Studs,Enum.ScaleType.Stretch
	pattern.ImageRectOffset,pattern.ImageRectSize=Vector2.zero,Vector2.zero
	pattern.Position,pattern.AnchorPoint,pattern.Rotation=UDim2.new(),Vector2.zero,0
	pattern.BackgroundTransparency,pattern.BorderSizePixel,pattern.Active=1,0,false
	if studBindings[pattern] then return pattern end
	local function resize()
		-- AbsoluteSize includes ancestor UIScales; offset sizes must use local pixels.
		local scale=1
		local ancestor: Instance?=clip
		while ancestor do
			if ancestor:IsA("GuiObject") then
				for _,child in ancestor:GetChildren() do
					if child:IsA("UIScale") then scale*=child.Scale end
				end
			end
			ancestor=ancestor.Parent
		end
		local size=clip.AbsoluteSize/math.max(scale,0.001)
		local relativeWidth=pattern:GetAttribute("StudScaleWidth")
		if type(relativeWidth)=="number" and relativeWidth>0 then
			-- Opt-in for fully scale-authored surfaces; keep the cropped sheet square.
			local side=math.max(size.X*relativeWidth,size.X,size.Y)
			pattern.Size=UDim2.fromScale(side/math.max(size.X,0.001),side/math.max(size.Y,0.001))
			return
		end
		local side=math.max((pattern:GetAttribute("StudSpacing") or 28)*24,size.X,size.Y)
		pattern.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(side,side)
	end
	local function layer()
		clip.ZIndex,clip.Visible=pattern.ZIndex,pattern.Visible
	end
	local connections={
		clip:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(resize),
		pattern.AncestryChanged:Connect(resize),
		pattern:GetAttributeChangedSignal("StudSpacing"):Connect(resize),
		pattern:GetAttributeChangedSignal("StudScaleWidth"):Connect(resize),
		pattern:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ZIndex"):Connect(layer),
		pattern:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(layer),
	}
	studBindings[pattern]=connections

function Theme.Number(value)
	value=value or 0
	if value>=1000000 then return string.format("%.1fm",value/1000000) end
	if value>=10000 then return string.format("%.1fk",value/1000) end
	if value==math.floor(value) then return tostring(math.floor(value)) end
	return string.format("%.1f",value)
end

-- Currency has whole coins. Keep exact prices readable instead of abbreviating
-- them to decimals; the floor also hides fractional frames in wallet tweens.
function Theme.Money(value)
	local whole=math.floor(value or 0)
	local digits=string.format("%.0f",math.abs(whole))
	local grouped=(digits:reverse():gsub("(%d%d%d)","%1,"):reverse():gsub("^,",""))
	return (if whole<0 then "-" else "")..grouped
end

-- Popup presentation is applied after rendering so page-specific fills cannot restore old colors.
function Theme.ApplyPopupStyle(panel)
	if not panel then return end
	local window=panel:FindFirstChild("StandardPage") or panel:FindFirstChild("Window") or panel
	local header=window:FindFirstChild("Header")
	local body=window:FindFirstChild("Main") or window:FindFirstChild("Body")
	if header then
		Theme.Studs(header,0.14,28,0).ZIndex=header.ZIndex
		for _,name in {"Title","PageIcon","Close"} do
			local foreground=header:FindFirstChild(name)
			if foreground and foreground:IsA("GuiObject") then
				foreground.ZIndex=math.max(foreground.ZIndex,header.ZIndex+1)
			end
		end
	end
	local function darkSurface(item,isBody)
		item.BackgroundColor3,item.BackgroundTransparency=Color3.new(1,1,1),0
		local gradient=item:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UIGradient") or Instance.new("UIGradient")
		gradient.Color=ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(20,22,24),Color3.fromRGB(3,4,5))
		gradient.Transparency=NumberSequence.new({
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,if isBody then 0.24 else 0.62),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,if isBody then 0.48 else 0.80),
		})
		gradient.Rotation,gradient.Parent=90,item
		local rim=item:FindFirstChild("InnerRim")
		if rim and rim:IsA("GuiObject") then rim.Visible=false end
		local stroke=item:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UIStroke")
		if stroke then
			if isBody then
				stroke.Color,stroke.Transparency,stroke.Thickness=Color3.fromRGB(6,8,9),0.12,3
			else
				stroke.Transparency=math.max(stroke.Transparency,0.42)
				stroke.Thickness=math.min(stroke.Thickness,2)
			end
		end
	end
	local protected={
		Fill=true,ProgressFill=true,Rarity=true,RarityBadge=true,
		Badge=true,SelectionOutline=true,InnerRim=true,
	}
	local function content(item)
		if item==header or item:GetAttribute("OwnsPopupStyle")==true then return end
		if protected[item.Name] or item:IsA("ViewportFrame") then return end
		-- Action-button visuals and their captions retain their authored colors.
		if item:IsA("GuiButton") and (item:FindFirstChild("Visual") or item.Name=="Buy") then return end
		if item:IsA("Frame") or item:IsA("GuiButton") then
			if item.BackgroundTransparency<1 or item:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UIGradient") then
				darkSurface(item,item==body)
			end
		elseif item:IsA("TextLabel") and item.Name~="TextShadow" then
			local _,_,value=item.TextColor3:ToHSV()
			if value<0.7 then
				item.TextColor3=if item.Name=="Title" or item.Name=="Current"
					then Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255) else Color3.fromRGB(224,230,233)
			end
		elseif item:IsA("TextBox") then
			item.BackgroundColor3,item.BackgroundTransparency=Color3.fromRGB(8,10,12),0.28
			item.TextColor3,item.PlaceholderColor3=Color3.fromRGB(245,248,250),Color3.fromRGB(172,185,192)
		elseif item:IsA("ImageLabel") and item.Name=="IconRays" then
			item.ImageTransparency=math.max(item.ImageTransparency,0.9)
		end
		for _,child in item:GetChildren() do content(child) end
	end
	for _,child in panel:GetChildren() do
		if child~=header then content(child) end
	end
end

function Browser:ColossalSlot(id)
	local pet=self.app:Pet(id)
	if not pet or not Giant.IsColossal(pet.giantSize) then return nil end
	for slot,otherId in self.app.state.selectedIds or {} do
		local other=self.app:Pet(otherId)
		if otherId~=id and other and Giant.IsColossal(other.giantSize) then return slot end
	end
	return nil
end


function Browser:OpenInventory()
	-- This is an explicit navigation action, never a state-refresh side effect.
	-- Inspection selection is local UI state; it does not equip or sell a chicken.
	if self.pending then return end
	local state=self.app.state
	if not state then return end
	self:CancelPointer(true)
	local pet=self.app:Pet(self.app.selected)
	if not pet then
		local equipped={}
		for _,id in state.selectedIds or {} do equipped[id]=true end
		local bestEquipped,bestPower=false,-math.huge
		for _,candidate in state.pets or {} do
			local isEquipped=equipped[candidate.id]==true or candidate.selected==true
			local power=Rules.PetPower(candidate.species,candidate.stars,candidate.level)
			if not pet or (isEquipped and not bestEquipped)
				or (isEquipped==bestEquipped and (power>bestPower or (power==bestPower and candidate.id<pet.id))) then
				pet,bestEquipped,bestPower=candidate,isEquipped,power
			end
		end
	end
	local id=if pet then pet.id else nil
	if self.app.selected~=id then self.saleQuote=nil end
	self.app.selected,self.lastSelected=id,id

function Browser:Send(action,payload)
	if self.pending then return end
	self.app.audio:Play("Click")
	local id=self.app:Request(action,payload)
	self.pending={id=id,at=os.clock(),action=action,petId=if action=="Sell" and payload then payload.petIds[1] else payload and payload.petId}
	if action~="Sell" then self.saleQuote=nil end
	self.notice=nil
	self:UpdateAction()
end

function Browser:Receive(result)
	if self.pending and result and result.id==self.pending.id then
		local pending=self.pending
		self.pending=nil
		if pending.action=="Sell" then
			self.saleQuote=nil
			if result.ok and (self.app.selected==pending.petId or self.lastSelected==pending.petId) then
				self.app.selected,self.lastSelected,self.inspecting=nil,nil,false
			end
		end
		if pending.action=="UpgradeChicken" and result.ok then self.app.feedback:Action("Income") end
		self.notice=if result.ok then nil else result.message
		self.noticeUntil=os.clock()+4
	end
end

function Browser:UpdateAction()
	local state=self.app.state
	if not state then return end
	if self.pending and os.clock()-self.pending.at>5 then
		self.pending=nil;self.saleQuote=nil
		self.notice="No response yet. Try again.";self.noticeUntil=os.clock()+4
	end
	if self.notice and os.clock()>(self.noticeUntil or 0) then self.notice=nil end
	local pet=self.app:Pet(self.app.selected)
	if self.saleQuote and not self.pending and not self:SaleQuoteValid() then
		self.saleQuote=nil
		self.notice,self.noticeUntil="Your flock changed. Review the chicken again.",os.clock()+4
	end

function Browser:SaleEligible(pet)
	return pet~=nil and pet.canSell==true and not pet.selected and not pet.favorite
		and not pet.deployed and pet.home~=false and type(pet.refund)=="number"
		and pet.refund>=0 and pet.refund<math.huge
end

function Browser:SaleQuoteValid()
	local quote=self.saleQuote
	if not quote or self.app.selected~=quote.id or not self.app.state then return false end
	local pet=self.app:Pet(quote.id)
	return self:SaleEligible(pet) and pet.level==quote.level and pet.refund==quote.refund
		and self.app:PetIncome(pet)==quote.income
end

function Browser:ReviewSale()
	local pet=self.app:Pet(self.app.selected)

	self.app.audio:Play("Click");self:CancelPointer(true)

function Browser:TogglePet(id)
	if self.pending then return end
	if not self:CanEdit() then
		self.notice,self.noticeUntil="Wait for the current change.",os.clock()+4
		self:UpdateAction();return
	end
	local pet=self.app:Pet(id)
	if not pet then return end
	self.saleQuote=nil
	local ids=self.app.state.selectedIds or {}
	local slot=table.find(ids,id)
	if self.placing then
		if slot then self:Drop(self.placing,slot,false,self.placingExpected or ids) end
	elseif slot then self:Drop(id,nil,true,ids)
	elseif self:ColossalSlot(id) then self:Drop(id,self:ColossalSlot(id),false,ids)
	elseif #ids<self.app.state.capacity then self:Drop(id,#ids+1,false,ids)
	else
		self.app.audio:Play("Click")
		self.placing,self.placingExpected=id,table.clone(ids)
		self.inspecting,self.showInfo=false,false
		self.search.Text="";self.grid.CanvasPosition=Vector2.zero;self:Render(true)
	end
end

function Browser:Drop(id,slot,toFlock,expected)
	if not self:CanEdit() then return end
	local current=self.app.state.selectedIds or {}
	if table.concat(current,"|")~=table.concat(expected,"|") then
		self.notice,self.noticeUntil="Army changed. Choose again.",os.clock()+4
		self:Render(true);return
	end
	local ids=table.clone(expected)
	local old=table.find(ids,id)
	if slot then
		if old==slot then return end
		if old then
			if ids[slot] then ids[old],ids[slot]=ids[slot],id
			else table.remove(ids,old);table.insert(ids,id) end
		else ids[math.min(slot,#ids+1)]=id end
	elseif toFlock and old then table.remove(ids,old)
	else return end
	local colossals=0
	for _,petId in ids do local pet=self.app:Pet(petId);if pet and Giant.IsColossal(pet.giantSize) then colossals+=1 end end
	if colossals>Giant.MaxArmyColossals then
		self.notice,self.noticeUntil="Only 1 Colossal per army. Replace your equipped Colossal.",os.clock()+4
		self:UpdateAction();return
	end
	self.placing,self.placingExpected=nil,nil
	self:Send("SetArmy",{petIds=ids,expectedIds=table.clone(expected)})
end


function Browser:Highlight(target,toFlock)

	end
end

function Browser:DropTarget(point)
	if not inside(self.root,point) then return nil,false end
	if not inside(self.grid,point) then return nil,false end
	for index,entry in self.slots do
		if inside(entry.card,point) then return index,false end
	end
	local pointer=self.pointer
	if pointer then
		if table.find(pointer.expected,pointer.id) then return nil,true end
		if #pointer.expected<self.app.state.capacity then return #pointer.expected+1,false end
	end
	return nil,false
end

function Browser:CancelPointer(suppress)

function Browser:BeginPointer(pet,input)
	local touch=input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch
	if not touch and input.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then return end
	if not self:CanEdit() then return end
	if self.saleQuote then self.saleQuote=nil;self:UpdateAction() end
	self:CancelPointer(false)
	local point=pointOf(input)
	local pointer={id=pet.id,input=input,touch=touch,start=point,point=point,
		expected=table.clone(self.app.state.selectedIds or {}),dragging=false}
	self.pointer=pointer
	if touch then
		task.delay(0.22,function()
			if self.pointer==pointer and (pointer.point-pointer.start).Magnitude<10 then self:StartDrag() end
		end)
	end
end

function Browser:PointerChanged(input)
	local pointer=self.pointer
	if not pointer then return end
	if pointer.touch then if input~=pointer.input then return end
	elseif input.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then return end
	pointer.point=pointOf(input)
	if not pointer.dragging then
		local distance=(pointer.point-pointer.start).Magnitude
		if pointer.touch and distance>=10 then self:CancelPointer(true);return
		elseif not pointer.touch and distance>=6 then self:StartDrag() end
	end
	if pointer.dragging and pointer.ghost then
		pointer.ghost.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(pointer.point.X-56,pointer.point.Y-70)
		local target,toFlock=self:DropTarget(pointer.point);self:Highlight(target,toFlock)
	end
end

function Browser:PointerEnded(input)
	local pointer=self.pointer
	if not pointer then return end
	if pointer.touch then if input~=pointer.input then return end
	elseif input.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then return end
	local target,toFlock=self:DropTarget(pointer.point)
	local dragged=pointer.dragging
	self:CancelPointer(dragged)
	if dragged then
		self:Drop(pointer.id,target,toFlock,pointer.expected)
		self:Render(true)
	end
end

function Browser:Render(force)

	if self.pointer then
		if not self:CanEdit() or not self.app:Pet(self.pointer.id) then self:CancelPointer(true)
		else self:UpdateAction();return end
	end
	local ids=state.selectedIds or {}
	local pets,chosen,ordered={},{},{}
	for _,pet in state.pets or {} do pets[pet.id]=pet;table.insert(ordered,pet) end
	for slot,id in ids do chosen[id]=slot end
	table.sort(ordered,function(a,b)
		if self.sort=="Name" then
			local an,bn=Catalog[a.species].name,Catalog[b.species].name
			if an~=bn then return an<bn end
		end
		local pa,pb=Rules.PetPower(a.species,a.stars,a.level),Rules.PetPower(b.species,b.stars,b.level)
		if pa~=pb then return pa>pb end
		return a.id<b.id
	end)
	if self.app.selected and not pets[self.app.selected] then self.app.selected=nil;self.inspecting=false end
	if self.app.selected and self.app.selected~=self.lastSelected then
		self.inspecting,self.showInfo,self.showCapacity=true,false,false
	end
	self.lastSelected=self.app.selected
	if not self.inspecting or self.showInfo or self.showCapacity or not self.app.selected then self.saleQuote=nil end
	if not self:CanEdit() or (self.placing and not pets[self.placing]) then self.placing,self.placingExpected=nil,nil end
	local dimensions=self:Resize()
	self.app.panelTitle.Text=if self.showInfo then "Army Info"
		elseif self.showCapacity then "More Army Slots" else "Your Chickens!"
	self.title.Text=self.app.panelTitle.Text
	local mode=if state.selectionMode=="Manual" then "Manual lineup" else "Best selected"
	self.summary.Text=string.format('<font color="#F9CE43">%d</font> / %d',#ordered,state.collectionLimit or Config.CollectionLimit)
	self.capacity.Text=string.format('<font color="#F9CE43">%d</font> / %d',#ids,state.capacity)
	self.sortButton.Text=if self.placing then "Cancel" elseif self.sort=="Name" then "Name A-Z" else "Best first"
	local keys={dimensions,self.app.selected or "",table.concat(ids,","),tostring(state.capacity),mode,
		tostring(state.incoming),tostring(state.outgoing),state.armyState,tostring(state.incomeLevel),
		tostring(state.homeEggsPerSecond),self.query,self.sort,self.placing or ""}
	for _,pet in state.pets or {} do
		table.insert(keys,pet.id..":"..pet.species..":"..pet.stars..":"..pet.level..":"..tostring(pet.giantSize)..":"..tostring(pet.home)..":"..tostring(pet.deployed)..":"..tostring(pet.levelCap))
	end
	local key=table.concat(keys,"|")
	if key==self.key and not force then self:UpdateAction();return end
	self.key=key
	local scroll=self.grid.CanvasPosition
	clear(self.grid);self.slots,self.cards={},{}
	local visible={}
	for _,pet in ordered do

		if self.query=="" or string.find(searchText,self.query,1,true) then table.insert(visible,pet) end
	end

local function chanceText(chance)
 if type(chance)~="number" or chance<=0 then return "0%" end
 local percent=chance*100
 local digits=math.clamp(4-math.min(0,math.floor(math.log10(percent))),4,12)
 return string.format("%."..digits.."f",percent):gsub("0+$",""):gsub("%.$","").."%"
end

function Browser:RenderDetails()
 if not self.detailsKind or not self.detailsRoot.Visible then return end
 local shop=self.app.state and self.app.state.shop
 local rows={}
 local available=false
 local guaranteed=guaranteedOffers(shop)
 local note="Your available benefit is still being checked."
 if guaranteed then
  local guarantee=shop.luckGuarantee
  available=type(guarantee)=="table" and type(guarantee.sequence)=="table" and #guarantee.sequence>0
   and type(guarantee.interval)=="number" and guarantee.interval>0
   and type(guarantee.rollsRemaining)=="number" and PetCatalog[guarantee.nextSpecies]~=nil
  self.detailsTitle.Text="2x Luck · Guaranteed Offers"
  self.detailsDescription.Text="For this account, 2x Luck gives a known Rare+ offer every 10 manual rolls; regular rolls keep their normal odds. Normal coin price applies; higher-level offers cost more. Offers last until reroll or leaving."
  if available then
   table.insert(rows,{name="Fixed repeating order",value="Level 1 price (coins)"})
   for index,species in guarantee.sequence do
    local pet=PetCatalog[species]
    if not pet or type(pet.price)~="number" then available=false;break end
    table.insert(rows,{name=index..". "..pet.name,value=Theme.Money(pet.price).." coins"})
   end
   if available then
    local owned=shop.owned and shop.owned.DoubleLuck
    note=(if owned then "Next: " else "After purchase, next: ")..PetCatalog[guarantee.nextSpecies].name
     .." in "..guarantee.rollsRemaining..(if guarantee.rollsRemaining==1 then " roll" else " rolls")
     ..". Progress saves; this order repeats."
   end
  end
 elseif shop and shop.policyReady==true and shop.paidRandomAllowed==true then
  self.detailsTitle.Text="2x Luck · roll chances"
  self.detailsDescription.Text="Doubles Rare+ weights before all chances are normalized. Your current coin Luck upgrades are included."

  if available then
   table.insert(rows,{name="Every possible chicken",value="Without pass  →  With pass"})
   for _,species in PetCatalog.Order do

function Browser:BindOfferMotion(view,section)
 view.section=section
 table.insert(self.motionViews,view)
 local function pose(hot)
  if not self.alive then return end
  local scale=Theme.Motion:Scale(view.art)
  local active=hot and self.root.Visible and self.root.Parent.Visible and not self.app.reducedMotion
  Theme.Motion:Tween(scale,"shop-art",{Scale=if active then 1.065 else 1},0.2,Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
  -- Keep GUI ancestors upright so scrolling still clips the hover animation.
  view.art.Rotation=0
 end
 table.insert(self.connections,view.root.MouseEnter:Connect(function() pose(true) end))
 table.insert(self.connections,view.root.MouseLeave:Connect(function() pose(false) end))
 if view.buy then
  table.insert(self.connections,view.buy.SelectionGained:Connect(function() pose(true) end))
  table.insert(self.connections,view.buy.SelectionLost:Connect(function() pose(false) end))
 end
end

function Browser:CancelArtworkMotion()
 self.entranceSerial+=1
 for _,view in self.motionViews do
  Theme.Motion:Cancel(view.art,"shop-tilt")
  local scale=view.art:FindFirstChild("MotionScale")
  if scale then
   Theme.Motion:Cancel(scale,"scale");Theme.Motion:Cancel(scale,"shop-art");scale.Scale=1
  end
  view.art.Rotation=0
 end
end

function Browser:AnimateSection(section)
 self:CancelArtworkMotion()
 if self.app.reducedMotion or not self.root.Visible or not self.root.Parent.Visible then return end
 local serial=self.entranceSerial
 local index=0
 for _,view in self.motionViews do
  if view.section==section then
   local delay=index*0.035
   index+=1
   task.delay(delay,function()
    if not self.alive or self.entranceSerial~=serial or self.app.reducedMotion or not self.root.Visible or not self.root.Parent.Visible then return end
    Theme.Motion:Pop(view.art,0.88)
   end)
  end
 end
end

function Browser:CancelScroll()

end

function Browser:RefreshScrollMetrics()
 if not self.alive then return end
 local scroll=self.scroll
 local first=self.sections.Passes
 local authored=first.Size.Y.Offset
 self.scrollScale=if authored>0 then first.AbsoluteSize.Y/authored else 1
 self.sectionStarts={}
 for key,section in self.sections do
  self.sectionStarts[key]=section.AbsolutePosition.Y-scroll.AbsolutePosition.Y+scroll.CanvasPosition.Y
 end
 self.maxScroll=math.max(0,scroll.AbsoluteCanvasSize.Y-scroll.AbsoluteWindowSize.Y)
end

function Browser:ScrollTo(key)
 self:CloseDetails()
 self:RefreshScrollMetrics()
 if not self.sectionStarts[key] then return end
 self:CancelScroll()
 local target=Vector2.new(0,math.clamp(self.sectionStarts[key]-4*self.scrollScale,0,self.maxScroll))
 if self.app.reducedMotion then self.scroll.CanvasPosition=target;return end
 self.scrollTween=TweenService:Create(self.scroll,TweenInfo.new(0.32,Enum.EasingStyle.Quart,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),{CanvasPosition=target})
 self.scrollFinished=self.scrollTween.Completed:Connect(function(state)
  if state==Enum.PlaybackState.Completed then self:AnimateSection(key) end
 end)
 self.scrollTween:Play()
end

function Browser:UpdateSection()
 if not self.alive then return end
 self:RefreshScrollMetrics()
 local y,active=self.scroll.CanvasPosition.Y,"Passes"
 for _,key in {"Passes","Cash"} do
  if y>=self.sectionStarts[key]-28*self.scrollScale then active=key end
 end
 if self.maxScroll>0 and y>=self.maxScroll-2*self.scrollScale then active="Cash" end
 if active==self.activeSection then return end
 self.activeSection=active
 for key,button in self.tabs do
  local selected=key==active
  button.TextColor3=if selected then P.gold else P.white
  button.Visual.SelectedIndicator.Visible=selected
  button:SetAttribute("Selected",selected)
 end
end
